{{GameIntro
|image= arma3_helicopters_logo.png

|version= 1.34
|releasedate= 4th November, 2014 
|intro= [[Arma 3 Helicopters]] is a paid DLC that was first announced on May 1st, 2014. The DLC includes a wide range of features, including '''sling loading''', '''two new helicopters''' and '''firing from vehicles''' (FFV). An updated flight model, commonly called '''RotorLib''', has also been included. This flight-model is an upgraded version of the flight model seen in [[Take On Helicopters]]. RotorLib is entirely optional and players still have the possibility to choose between RotorLib and the old flight model, which has been present since {{GameCategory|arma2|link= y}}. A wide variety of free content has also been pushed out with the new game version, which added the {{GameCategory|arma3|link= y}} Helicopters DLC, including free new time trials, skin variants and multiple game-changing features.
|premfeature1= '''CH-67 Huron''' - A BLUFOR Logistical Support helicopter intended to lift heavy loads.
|premfeature2= '''Mi-290 Taru''' - The OPFOR equivalent of the CH-67 Huron.
|premfeature3= '''Showcase''' - Sling Loading
|supportfeature1= VR Training for Helicopters
|supportfeature2= Five new time trails
|supportfeature3= [[Arma_3_CfgVehicles_CIV#C_Heli_Light_01_civil_F|M-900]] - Civilian variant of the NATO MH-9 Hummingbird helicopter. 
|supportfeature4= ''Support'' Multiplayer mode
|supportfeature5= Variety of Steam Achievements
|supportfeature6= Optional RotorLib flight model.
|supportfeature7= Wide variety of new objects for mission makers, such as landing pads or ropes.
|supportfeature8= Firing from Vehicles, where seated passengers are able to fire their guns inside a vehicle.
|supportfeature9= Sling Loading
